_doc: The model data of Hardtech-CAD (libs:cad-core ModelManifest, schema 2), bundled in the APK. Everything the app shows is declared here: the Model, Extension and Software filters, the models table and the model page are derived from it, nothing is typed in the app. Top level: `categories` (the Model filter: id + label, in order; a category with no model still shows). `originals_repo`: the public LFS repo that holds the original files (`path` is relative to it). Per model: id, name, category (a categories id), library (boats | architecture: the app's format pages), software (the authoring software), format (lower-case extension family), path, source, licence, size (bytes), sha256 (of the original at path), updated (YYYY-MM-DD), units (of the view), stats {vertices, triangles} and bbox {min, max} (measured from the GLB view), material_count / materials, layer_count / layers, component_count, conversion_log (what was done, in order). `view` is the derived, triangulated GLB the app renders: `asset` (its path under app/src/main/assets, bundled in the APK so it renders offline and never depends on LFS or the network), `path` (where it came from in the originals repo, for a mirrored view), format, size, sha256, tool (provenance: tool and version), vertices, triangles. `derived` lists other derivatives (IFC4, under data/derived/). The original stays the source of truth. `conversion` says why a closed format has no view. Written by tools/derive_models.py (CI: .github/workflows/hardtech-cad-models.yml), checked by tools/check_models.py (test/test-models-renderable.sh) and tools/verify-models.mjs.

models.name: One Lilo, 36 m sailing yacht
models.source: Owner's own file (Google Drive, archive 36-meter-sailing-yacht-1.snapshot.9.zip, member OneLilo.igs)

view.tool: tools/brep2glb.mjs with occt-import-js 0.0.23 (LGPL-2.1), linear deflection 0.08 of the bounding box (254k triangles), merged by colour; mirrored from the originals repo, hash-checked by ad_Hardtech-CAD/tools/derive_models.py

conversion_log: original: IGES 5.3 written by Rhinoceros (Jun 24 2014), global section units 1HM (metres); 66128 directory entities on 32 layers; part names inside (Radar..SLDPRT) show a SolidWorks origin
view: tools/brep2glb.mjs with occt-import-js 0.0.23 (LGPL-2.1), linear deflection 0.08 of the bounding box, triangles merged by colour into one mesh with one material
view re-made lighter on 2026-11-03 (20.6 MB to 7.7 MB, 254076 triangles) so phones and the emulator can draw it (commit c8b0577)
checked: plain glTF 2.0 binary, no Draco or meshopt compression, no required extension; CI guard tools/verify-models.mjs parses it with @gltf-transform/core

models.name: Campidoglio, Musei Capitolini, Palazzo Senatorio, Roma
conversion_log: openskp 1.5.0 parsed it: 16 definitions, 4 layers, 41 materials
glb.export(skp, view) wrote the GLB; wrapped in a 0.001 scale node (openskp writes millimetres, glTF is metres); colours, no textures
ifc.export(skp.build_scene(), ifc) wrote the IFC4 file (meshes, no BIM semantics)

models.name: Drone, civilian 250-class camera quadcopter
models.source: Generated by ad_Hardtech-CAD/tools/make_drone.py (own parametric model, civilian consumer camera quadcopter, no weapon or payload)

view.tool: ad_Hardtech-CAD/tools/make_drone.py (pure Python, glTF 2.0 binary, flat-shaded, one mesh with one primitive per material)

conversion_log: original: the generator ad_Hardtech-CAD/tools/make_drone.py (X frame, four motors with two-blade propellers, camera gimbal, landing skids), metres, Y up
view: the same script writes the GLB (plain glTF 2.0 binary, no Draco or meshopt, no required extension), about 100 KB bundled in the APK

models.name: House Boat, two-deck pontoon houseboat
models.source: Owner's own file (archive boat-house-3.zip, member House Boat.obj, written by assimp 5.2; no .mtl shipped, colours from the material names in boats/obj/house-boat.colours.json)

view.tool: tools/obj2glb.mjs (pure Node), scale 0.001 (millimetres to metres), one primitive per material; mirrored from the originals repo, hash-checked by ad_Hardtech-CAD/tools/derive_models.py

conversion_log: original: Wavefront OBJ written by assimp 5.2, 12044 vertices, 23652 triangles, 5 materials (usemtl, Russian names), millimetres, Y-up; the .mtl was not in the archive

view: tools/obj2glb.mjs (pure Node) in the originals repo, scale 0.001 to metres, one primitive per material, colours from boats/obj/house-boat.colours.json (vanilla plastic, oak chipboard, aluminium, blue plastic, steel)
thumbnail: the owner's reference photo (boats/photos/house-boat-7.jpg in the originals repo), cover-cropped to 480x360 JPEG

conversion_log: original: STEP AP214 (AUTOMOTIVE_DESIGN) written by SolidWorks 2015 (SwSTEP 2.0), 22.3 MB, 237 solids in 15 colours, metres, Y-up
